extracted.name: Hard Chocolate Glaze
extracted.description: A chocolate glaze that sets up hard. Use it on cakes or brownies.
instruction_lines: Chop chocolate into small pieces; add to top of a double boiler over simmering water. Add butter; stir frequently until melted and smooth. Remove from heat.
